summary.text: Hannah Pingree is the Democratic nominee for governor. She served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2002 to 2010, including as Speaker from 2008 to 2010, and directed Gov. Janet Mills's Office of Policy Innovation and the Future from 2019 to 2025.

paragraphs.text: Grew up on North Haven, Maine; graduated from Brown University with a degree in political science.
Served four terms in the Maine House (2002–2010), chairing the Health and Human Services Committee, serving as Majority Leader (2006–2008) and as Speaker (2008–2010).
Directed the Governor's Office of Policy Innovation and the Future under Gov. Janet Mills from 2019 to 2025.
